title_en: The Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad Heritage and Islamic Heritage - Episode 4
summary: This lecture by Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari continues the series 'Debates in Beliefs', exploring the representation of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad versus Islamic historical and religious heritage.
